gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads clean and contemporary, with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals in height. And Wallpoet is the one to push the volume, bold and commanding, while the sans keeps its curves open and quietly gets on with the words.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-parkinsans: Modern and crisp, Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout, and its wide-mouthed letters hold up when shrunk. But Wallpoet leads with a bold, commanding line where the paper shows through between its letters, so the two never look alike.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme has stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, which gives its rounded letters clear openings. And Wallpoet is best at commanding attention with its bold, cut-through lines, while the plain sans simply carries the text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-preahvihear: Loud meets lofty. Wallpoet's bold, commanding capitals and gapped lines sit above Preahvihear, a sans-serif whose open mouths and tall x-height give the text a modern, easygoing footing.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-prompt: Approachable and neutral, Prompt looks oversized in its small letters. Wallpoet brings the bold, commanding punch up top, and the plain sans below lets its open apertures do the quiet work of being read.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-pt-sans-caption: Professional but contemporary, PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed and inviting, set under Wallpoet's bold, commanding display. Page after page, the sans-serif would feel generous.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-puritan: Puritan is a clean, approachable sans-serif with rounded forms that stay open to the side and oversized e and a counters. Wallpoet sits above it, bold and gapped.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads contemporary and businesslike, its lowercase c, s and z standing tall and full on a ruler-straight line. And over a longer passage, that sans-serif stays clear at every curve's end, a calm contrast to Wallpoet's bold display.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-radio-canada-big:
Wallpoet's lines break where the paper shows through between letters.

Radio Canada Big answers with a monoline skeleton, terminals clear of the stem and a tall x-height, so the sans-serif feels like solid ground beneath that commanding display.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-readex-pro: Commanding is how Wallpoet announces itself, best at making bold, gapped shapes that grab a line. Readex Pro is best at the opposite, a plain sans with broad terminal gaps and an unvarying weight from word to word.
